description: The Global Coalition to Protect Education from Attack publishes the data behind its flagship report, Education under Attack, and the tables are on the Humanitarian Data Exchange with yearly updates. Files cover 2013 to 2017 incidents of attacks on education, students and education staff harmed, and the severity of attacks by country, then annual workbooks for 2018 to 2019, 2020, 2020 to 2021, 2022 and 2023; the dataset date runs from 2013 to 2024. The report is independent research by GCPEA, supported by the Education Above All Foundation and the Norwegian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, with in-kind research support from Columbia University's Mailman School of Public Health. Coverage: countries with reported attacks on schools, universities, students and staff. Access: Excel and CSV files on HDX. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: the data are compiled from reported incidents, described on HDX as direct observational or anecdotal data, so under-reporting varies by country and year, and the page does not describe the columns. Simulation uses are records of attacks affecting schools and universities, for conflict-damage scenarios and continuity planning for education services. Related records: the Insecurity Insight incident data and the Syria schools survey.
